_comment: Tolerances, period windows and combination-search limits (spec 3.2, 3.3, 3.4).

tolerance._note: per document: 2 halalas for rounding, or 0.05 percent of value, whichever is larger

period._note: Common overlapping window is the intersection of the three per-file date ranges. erp_date_field is an open decision (spec 9): accounting date (voucher_date) vs document_date. Default is voucher_date (accounting/fiscal period), which places the December e-invoice batch out of period. Override on the CLI with --period-from / --period-to.
